nodes.name: config.rs
nodes.summary: Loads and caches housekeeper auto-compaction configuration (account, model, context limit) from application settings, exposing enable/disable and refresh accessors.

nodes.name: parse_settings
nodes.summary: Parses raw settings JSON into a HousekeeperCompactionConfig, extracting account id, model, and context-limit fields.

nodes.name: update_from_settings
nodes.summary: Applies a freshly parsed settings snapshot to the shared in-memory compaction config store.

nodes.name: refresh_from_disk
nodes.summary: Reloads housekeeper compaction settings from disk and updates the in-memory config store.

nodes.name: current
nodes.summary: Returns a clone of the currently cached housekeeper compaction configuration.

nodes.name: HousekeeperCompactionConfig
nodes.summary: Holds the account, model, and context-limit settings used to drive background housekeeper compaction.

nodes.name: history.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the chunk-selection algorithm for housekeeper compaction, determining which message ranges to summarize next based on token budgets and structural boundaries.

nodes.name: prefix_hash
nodes.summary: Computes a stable hash over a message-history prefix used to detect whether a prior compaction summary is still valid.

nodes.name: structurally_matches
nodes.summary: Checks whether a canonical message and a current message are structurally equivalent for compaction cache validation.

nodes.name: summary_message
nodes.summary: Builds the synthetic assistant message representing a compaction summary for a covered message range.

nodes.name: recent_tail_start
nodes.summary: Determines the starting index of the recent message tail that should be preserved uncompacted.

nodes.name: select_next_chunk
nodes.summary: Core chunk-selection algorithm choosing the next message range to compact given history, prior coverage, and a context-limit-derived token budget.

nodes.name: RunMode
nodes.summary: Enum distinguishing background-triggered from explicitly-requested compaction runs.

nodes.name: SelectedChunk
nodes.summary: Represents a selected message range to compact along with its token accounting.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Public entry point for the housekeeper compaction subsystem, exposing status queries, enable/disable toggles, and the on-demand compaction trigger; re-exports the config, history, overlay, persistence, and worker submodules.

nodes.name: unavailable
nodes.summary: Builds a status response indicating the housekeeper compaction feature is unavailable for a session.

nodes.name: status
nodes.summary: Reports the current housekeeper compaction status for a session, combining persisted state with runtime availability checks.

nodes.name: set_enabled
nodes.summary: Enables or disables housekeeper compaction for a session and persists the change.

nodes.name: HousekeeperCompactionStatus
nodes.summary: Enum representing the lifecycle states of a housekeeper compaction run.

nodes.name: HousekeeperContextCompactionState
nodes.summary: Aggregated compaction state returned to the frontend describing progress and outcome of housekeeper compaction.

nodes.name: overlay.rs
nodes.summary: Applies compaction summary overlays onto the live message history, replacing covered messages with their summary while preserving runtime system prefixes.

nodes.name: apply
nodes.summary: Overlays a persisted compaction summary onto the session's message history, splicing in the summary message and preserving any leading runtime system messages.

nodes.name: OverlayOutcome
nodes.summary: Enum describing the result of attempting to apply a compaction overlay to session history.

nodes.name: persistence.rs
nodes.summary: SQLite persistence layer for housekeeper compaction records, providing schema initialization and operations to load, enable, and update per-session compaction state.

nodes.name: init_schema
nodes.summary: Creates the housekeeper compaction SQLite table if it does not already exist.

nodes.name: set_enabled
nodes.summary: Persists the enabled/disabled flag for housekeeper compaction on a session, upserting a default record if none exists.

nodes.name: acquire_run
nodes.summary: Attempts to atomically claim the housekeeper compaction run lock for a session, transitioning it to a running status.

nodes.name: mark_idle
nodes.summary: Marks a session's housekeeper compaction record as idle after a run completes without error.

nodes.name: mark_error
nodes.summary: Records a housekeeper compaction failure and error message against a session's persisted state.

nodes.name: reset_progress
nodes.summary: Resets the covered-message progress markers for a session's housekeeper compaction record.

nodes.name: save_success
nodes.summary: Persists a successful housekeeper compaction outcome, updating the summary, covered range, and token counts.

nodes.name: background_candidates
nodes.summary: Queries for sessions eligible for background housekeeper compaction up to a given limit.

nodes.name: CompactionRecord
nodes.summary: Row-mapped record representing a session's persisted housekeeper compaction state.

nodes.name: worker.rs
nodes.summary: Background worker that drives housekeeper compaction runs, orchestrating history loading, chunk selection, summarization, and persistence for both scheduled and explicit compaction requests.

nodes.name: response_from_record
nodes.summary: Builds a housekeeper compaction status response from a persisted record and explicit status/message overrides.

nodes.name: error_response
nodes.summary: Constructs an error-status compaction response and persists the failure for a session.

nodes.name: run_once
nodes.summary: Executes a single housekeeper compaction cycle for a session: loads history, selects the next chunk, summarizes it, and persists the result.

nodes.name: enqueue_explicit
nodes.summary: Queues an explicit, user- or system-triggered housekeeper compaction request onto the session's message scheduler.

nodes.name: run_explicit
nodes.summary: Runs an explicitly requested housekeeper compaction for a session and returns its outcome.

nodes.name: background_tick
nodes.summary: Performs one tick of the background housekeeper compaction scheduler, selecting and compacting eligible sessions.

nodes.name: spawn
nodes.summary: Spawns the background housekeeper compaction worker loop as a Tokio task.

nodes.name: launch_helpers.rs
nodes.summary: Collection of helper functions supporting agent session launch: validating agent org definitions, resolving per-member runtime overrides, and handling launch failures and provenance metadata.

nodes.name: handle_background_launch_failure
nodes.summary: Handles a failure during background session launch by marking the session/run as failed and broadcasting an error.

nodes.name: apply_member_launch_overrides_to_snapshot
nodes.summary: Recursively applies per-member launch overrides onto an agent org snapshot.

nodes.name: validate_launch_agent_definitions
nodes.summary: Validates that an agent org (and all its members) reference existing, non-duplicate agent definitions before a launch proceeds.

nodes.name: member_runtime_model
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective model for an org member, falling back to a default when not overridden.

nodes.name: member_runtime_account_id
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective account id for an org member, falling back to a default when not overridden.

nodes.name: member_runtime_key_source
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective API key source for an org member, falling back to a default when not overridden.

nodes.name: member_runtime_native_harness_type
nodes.summary: Resolves the effective native harness type for an org member, falling back to a default when not overridden.

nodes.name: provenance_fields
nodes.summary: Extracts launch provenance fields (source, work item, routine) for persistence on a launched session.

nodes.name: provenance_lock_reason
nodes.summary: Derives a human-readable lock reason string from a launch provenance value.

nodes.name: mark_session_failed
nodes.summary: Marks a session as failed in the database after an unsuccessful launch.

nodes.name: derive_name
nodes.summary: Derives a display name for a launched session from explicit input or initial message content.

nodes.name: flatten_org_members
nodes.summary: Flattens a nested agent org member tree into a flat list.

nodes.name: launch_org.rs
nodes.summary: Orchestrates materialization of agent-org member sessions during a multi-agent org launch, spawning child sessions and sending their initial turns.

nodes.name: spawn_agent_org_member_materialization
nodes.summary: Spawns an async task that materializes all member sessions for an agent org run.

nodes.name: materialize_org_member_sessions
nodes.summary: Creates and launches a session for every member of an agent org run, wiring up workspace, model, and account configuration for each.

nodes.name: send_initial_turn
nodes.summary: Sends the first turn/message into a newly launched session to kick off agent execution.

nodes.name: cleanup_session_after_org_run_create_failure
nodes.summary: Cleans up a partially created session if agent org run creation fails.
